parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set security nat source pool nat1 addres.template: set security nat source pool [parameter1] address [parameter2]/[parameter3] to [parameter4]/[parameter5]
set security nat source pool nat1 addres.command: set security nat source pool nat1 address 10.34.161.101/24 to 10.34.161.105/24
set security nat source pool nat1 addres.explanation: 配置NAT源地址池的地址范围。

parameters.name: start-mask
parameters.explanation: 起始地址的子网掩码位数。

parameters.name: end-mask
parameters.explanation: 结束地址的子网掩码位数。

set security nat source rule-set source-.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] from zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set source-.command: set security nat source rule-set source-nat-rules from zone trust
set security nat source rule-set source-.explanation: 配置NAT源规则集的源区域。

set security nat source rule-set source-.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] to zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set source-.command: set security nat source rule-set source-nat-rules to zone untrust
set security nat source rule-set source-.explanation: 配置NAT源规则集的目的区域。

set security nat source rule-set source-.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] match source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set security nat source rule-set source-.command: set security nat source rule-set source-nat-rules rule rule1 match source-address 10.10.10.0/24
set security nat source rule-set source-.explanation: 配置NAT源规则集中规则的源地址匹配条件。

parameters.name: source-mask
parameters.explanation: 源地址的子网掩码位数。

set security nat source rule-set source-.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] then source-nat pool [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set source-.command: set security nat source rule-set source-nat-rules rule rule1 then source-nat pool nat1
set security nat source rule-set source-.explanation: 配置NAT源规则集中规则的NAT动作。

set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.command: set firewall family inet filter acl-2001 term allow-traffic from source-address 10.10.10.0/24
set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器中术语的源地址匹配条件。

parameters.name: source-mask
parameters.explanation: 源地址的子网掩码位数。

set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.command: set firewall family inet filter acl-2001 term allow-traffic then accept
set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器中术语的动作。

set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.11.2/24
set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet filter input [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 family inet filter input acl-2001
set interfaces ge-2/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的输入过滤器。
